corePassives.description:
All of Mayuri Kurotsuchi's damage-dealing attacks apply a certain amount of Poison Scale to enemies. When it reaches 100, the Poison debuff is triggered once, dealing damage equal to 100% of ATK. 
 Each time Poison is triggered, all characters in the team gain 1 stack of Excitement, increasing their Ailment Mastery by 7.5% for 15 seconds, up to 3 stacks.
corePassives.name: Toxin Encroachment

corePassives.description: Increases Mayuri Kurotsuchi's Ultimate Charge Rate during battle by 50%.
corePassives.name: Research Obsession

corePassives.description: Increases Mayuri Kurotsuchi's Ailment DMG Bonus during battle by 75%.
corePassives.name: Formulation

corePassives.description: Each time a debuff on an enemy is triggered, the Crit DMG of the one who triggered it is increased by 100% for 30 seconds. Unstackable.
corePassives.name: Terror

skills.description:
Mayuri Kurotsuchi wields his Zanpakuto to strike 5 times, dealing damage equal to 375% of ATK to the enemy ahead and applying Poison Scale. ~~Masterpiece~~ After releasing a Technique, tap Basic Attack 
 Mayuri Kurotsuchi summons Nemu onto the field to assist. Nemu performs a rapid spinning kick, pulling in nearby enemies to a certain extent, dealing damage equal to 450% of Mayuri's ATK and applying Poison Scale.
skills.name: Claw out, Ashisogi Jizo

skills.description:
Mayuri Kurotsuchi randomly selects and uses one of the three following inventions: Hojiku-zai, Superhuman Potion, or Flesh Bomb. Each release of his Technique accumulates his Spiritual Pressure. When it reaches maximum, the Technique is enhanced into Double-Barreled. ~~Hojiku-zai~~ 
 Immediately restores HP to the entire team equal to 40%+450 of Mayuri Kurotsuchi's ATK, then restores 150 Fixed HP every 2 seconds for 10 seconds. 
 This skill is prioritized only when a team member's HP falls below 70%. ~~Superhuman Potion Essence~~  
 Inflicts all enemies within range with Delay for 5 second(s) and increases all damage they take by 15% for 25 seconds. ~~Flesh Bomb~~ 
 Attacks enemies in front, dealing damage equal to 640% of ATK, additionally reducing their Spiritual Pressure by 800, and applying Poison Scale. ~~Double-Barreled~~ 
 Mayuri Kurotsuchi uses both Superhuman Potion Essence and Flesh Bomb at once, dealing damage equal to 640% of ATK to enemies within range, additionally reducing their Spiritual Pressure by 800, and applying Poison Scale. Inflicts all enemies within range with Delay for 5 second(s) and increases all damage they take by 15% for 25 seconds.
skills.name: Picking the Right One

skills.description:
Mayuri Kurotsuchi releases his Bankai and commands the massive Konjiki Ashisogijizo to smash into enemies, dealing damage equal to 800% of ATK. On hit, it applies Poison Scale. Additionally, leaves behind a corrosive pool for 25 seconds, dealing total DMG equal to 185% of ATK to enemies within its area. 
 After this skill is released, all characters in the team gain 5% All-Skill Mastery for 35 seconds. Unstackable.
skills.name: Bankai: Konjiki Ashisogijizo

skills.description: After Mayuri Kurotsuchi blocks an enemy attack with Ashisogi Jizo, he commands Nemu to unleash a series of attacks, dealing damage equal to 675% of Mayuri Kurotsuchi's ATK and applying Poison Scale.
skills.name: Counter

skills.description: Use Flash Step to avoid attacks right before they hit. Perfect Dodges inflict True Time Freeze for 1.5 seconds, during which Mayuri Kurotsuchi gains 15% ASPD and 25% MSPD for 4 seconds. Cooldown: 15 seconds.
skills.name: Flash Step
